title: Linda McMahon Issues Warning To 'Entities That Continue To Allow Men To Compete In Women's Sports'
text:
Linda McMahon means business!
The Secretary of Education , in a Tuesday social media post, fired a warning shot to those who still allow males to compete in female sports.
President Donald Trump inked an executive order in February called “No Men in Women’s Sports” which bans transgender-identifying athletes from competing in female sports. Since then, however, a few states (all left-wing, of course) have gone out of their way to defy Trump’s order. You also have the NCAA, changed their policy involving transgender-identifying individuals but got into hot water for leaving loopholes allowing those athletes to compete. (RELATED: Radical Looney Tune Protester Removed, Arrested During Riley Gaines Event At San Francisco State)
Linda McMahon ain’t playing that nonsense.
“To all the entities that continue to allow men to compete in women’s sports and use women’s intimate facilities: there’s a new sheriff in town,” McMahon wrote in an X post . “The Trump Administration will not allow you to get away with denying women’s civil rights any longer.”
Wow, I love that woman.
